track: Scripted model and read-only MCP fixture; zero paid native-task model calls. Synthetic usage counters are protocol controls, not actual tokens or cost

products.DSH: 0.2.2-alpha.2 Web public session API, shipped read-only permission mode
products.OpenClaw: 2026.10.8 Gateway public HTTP agent entry, read-only target-tool allowlist and direct schemas

unit: One fresh native service/state/workspace, four independently random immutable file values. Same block values across products and conditions; real contexts/protocols remain native
operation: Native single and MCP single read the same indexed file content without an intentional tool delay. Four-read serial/batch/failure/cancel arms use the same four files and a 250 ms cancellable fixture delay before each actual read. Input contents are absent from the prompt and initial tool-call arguments
scheduling: Scripted serial reference issues each next call after observing the prior correlated result; it is provider-owned ordering. Batch response offers all four independent calls together. The harness chooses actual dispatch. OpenClaw public MCP supportsParallelToolCalls=true is an explicit integrator selection, not a claim about its default. No evaluator-side product semaphore or dispatch scheduler
fixture: Read-only stdio MCP child inside native cgroup. Supports concurrent JSON-RPC calls and notifications/cancelled, exact index-to-file mapping and independent monotonic receipt/read/result/stop records. Observer/model server is outside native cgroup. Fixture does not cancel itself from elapsed time
failure: Fail index 2 after actual MCP request receipt, before file read, with one identifiable isError result. Other calls behave normally; fixture/provider do not retry. Record any native attempts, result correlation, surviving successful work and final partial/error response. Correct handling is distinct from successful delivery of all four values
cancel: Hold MCP index 2 after receipt and before file read. Invoke public DSH session.cancel or native OpenClaw Gateway chat.abort through the native CLI. Retain request/receipt and separately charged inspector CLI CPU. Observe fixture/live-process/native-result-consumer state at 0.5, 2, 10 seconds after receipt; absence of effective native cancellation is not success. Verify native aborted terminal, no live held operation and no new old-task model dispatch; retain original outcomes even if cancellation fails. Cleanup release returns only an error, never performs the held read. Then run one fresh-session health task on the same service
controls: Run all four healthy conditions before reached failure/cancel arms in every block. Batch healthy control must pass before dependent batch faults; failed controls are retained and block dependent fault execution. An unreached boundary is trigger_not_reached or an adapter/fixture error, not a product failure
acceptance: Actual native assistant terminal output must contain exactly the random observed values with correct call/result index correlation. Batch failure must retain all three healthy values and the explicit error for index 2; classify full-task outcome failure even if handling is accepted. Cancellation uses native terminal/effective control, independent call cessation and subsequent health, not exit status alone
measurements: Full lifecycle and ready-to-result phase wall, dedicated 2-CPU/3-GiB cgroup CPU/memory, sampled PSS/RSS and actual timestamp RSS integration, native/MCP process identities, owned workspace/state/extension-ledger disk, separate observer/readonly-helper/native-inspector CPU. Record all model envelopes and tool schema/result payloads; actual token counts/source attribution and invoice cost unknown for scripted track
native_observability: Retain selected public histories and bounded native stdout separately from fixture truth. A frozen isolated native-only reconstruction must be scored against independently retained call/condition evidence; the informed controller does not count as a blind investigator

safeguards.meaning: Adapter/controlled-operation safeguards, not a universal real-task deadline

formal_admission: One complete pilot block, all twelve native arms with resources and usable controls. Publish measured full block, setup/cleanup and uncertainty before admitting two complete formal blocks; reverse product order in block two. Pilot observations excluded from formal count
limits: No real-model planning/quality or billing claim
Native single and MCP single latency includes their actual route responsibilities
Fresh state does not clear installation/OS caches
No diagnostic-logging or held native-event-consumer contrast yet
This bounded protocol does not complete every HD/H14 public component or event contrast
